title: Existence and uniqueness of the normalized internal scalar tensorator
statement: For every morphism a of commutative condensed rings and every scheme T, there is a unique natural isomorphism b: D_a(U tensor^L V) ≅ D_a(U) tensor^L D_a(V) satisfying TensorNormalized of [def-sfb-quotient-section-tensor-data], namely the stated computation square on every pair of flat-term K-flat complexes. No flatness or boundedness assumption is imposed.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YY, 0G7E, 07A4, 07A6; sites-modules.tex Tags 03EK and 03EL. Extracted from lem-sfb-quotient-section-tensor-normalization.

proof.text: Use the existing strong monoidal structure on internal scalar extension and its generic left-derived tensor comparison. The generic computation square on homotopy categories is transported through the quotient functor to the specified cochain computation square. For uniqueness, resolve both arguments by flat-term K-flat complexes, cancel the invertible computation map on their tensor product, and extend the equality by naturality along the resolution isomorphisms. The explicit canonical tensorator supplies existence.
